recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not resurrect the DSTU2 activity.detail.definition wording unless a future approved change reintroduces an activity-level definition element; if that happens, align the wording with current workflow-pattern extensions and CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityReference guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-11051 asked to explain or remove Questionnaire as an allowed target for CarePlan.activity.detail.definition. The Published resolution kept Questionnaire as a definition resource, rejected QuestionnaireResponse for this role because it is an event resource, and required the requirements text: "Allows Questionnaires that the patient (or practitioner) should fill in to fulfill the care plan activity."
initial_application: Commit c124072d7bc14dd9eea48ac1aaf530bcd31171a6 applied GF#11051 to the then-authoritative CarePlan spreadsheet by adding the required requirements text to CarePlan.activity.detail.definition. Later source conversion preserved the wording in structuredefinition-CarePlan.xml.
additional_context: CarePlan remains in the current build via source/fhir.ini, but active source no longer contains CarePlan.activity.detail.definition, CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail, CarePlan.instantiatesCanonical, or CarePlan.instantiatesUri. FHIR-39101 removed plannedActivityDetail in R5, and FHIR-40500 removed instantiates[x] from CarePlan in R6. The historical Questionnaire requirements text is now only inside a commented-out retired plannedActivityDetail block.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Editing the current source would either touch inactive retired XML or generated-looking diagram output, neither of which is needed to make the current built specification correct.
